scope: Main source-only profiling API path review; no new timing/count measurement, build or GPU operation.
facts: gpu.cpp event_record uses submit_profiling_tag for every timing=true Event even when STRATA_EVENT_MARK=barrier; barrier override selects non-timing events only.
gpu.cpp successful elapsed interval reads command_end twice, once for each endpoint. These are helper calls, not a measured backend driver-call count.
SYCL event_impl command_end checks profiling preconditions and forwards an actual event handle to its adapter.

L0 v2 urEventGetProfilingInfo locks the Event. For a timestamped Event it calls getEventEndTimestamp; a nonzero cached adjusted value returns without a new status query, otherwise it checks zeEventQueryStatus and adjusts the recorded global timestamp.
appendTimestampRecordingExp records a start timestamp before zeCommandListAppendWriteGlobalTimestamp. Enqueue overhead and held-event wait costs are outside fold-only measurement.

Existing Runtime::measure_marks returns immediately for explicit STRATA_EVENT_MARK override; no per-launch calibration occurs on this controller path. Its source comment names B70/CUDA measurements that are not fresh B570 measurements.
limitations: Mark/fold host wall alone need not explain time added inside existing stream_sync by held profiling events. Existing sync wall can include actual kernels and copies; no exclusive marker-cost inference.
The enabled profile and quiet samples differ in logging/validation as well as timing markers; do not subtract their wall difference as a calibrated timer cost.
No new calibration, exclusive GPU/DMA service, actual UR/ZE getter count or driver-hang causality assertion.
This checks these backend sources against the recorded tag commit and binds the installed compiler receipt; it is source path evidence, not a newly instrumented driver trace.
